	PROCEDURE analizarpermisoconsulta
		lParameters cId_comprobante, cId_sistema
		
			
		*If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comprobante,"C",oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_Comprobante,"C", cId_Sistema)
		
			If Type("thisform.oCntAccesoDenegado")=T_OBJECT
				thisform.ResetToDefault("Height")
				thisform.ResetToDefault("Width")
				
				thisform.oCntAccesoDenegado.Visible=.f.
			Endif	
			
		Else	
			If Type("thisform.oCntAccesoDenegado")<>T_OBJECT
				thisform.AddObject("oCntAccesoDenegado","Tg_AccesoDenegado")
			Endif
			thisform.Height=thisform.oCntAccesoDenegado.Height
			thisform.Width=thisform.oCntAccesoDenegado.Width
			thisform.oCntAccesoDenegado.Visible=.t.
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cancelar
		Local lRetorna
		If !thisform.Ocultar
			lRetorna=dodefault()
		Else
			thisform.Hide
			lRetorna=.f.
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcompimportacion
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cid_Comproba,nReferencia,lOperacion	
		Local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		If thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cid_Comproba+Str(nReferencia,10))	
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
			thisform.Id_Sucursal=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			thisform.Id_Sistema =thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema")
			
			***** Martin
			Thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
			Thisform.Copias=Thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Copias")
			***** Martin
			
			thisform.Operacion= lOperacion
		    thisform.Id_SucOperacion= thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_SucOperacion")
		    thisform.Id_Comproba=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		    thisform.Nro_Referencia= thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		    thisform.Nro_Operacion= thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Operacion")    
		    thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.buscar(cID_Sucursal+Str(Thisform.Nro_Operacion,10),.f.,"Clave")
		    thisform.Tg_TxbDescripcionOperacion.value= thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Descripcion")
			thisform.oTxbTotalSip.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Total_Sip")
			If thisform.oTxbTotalSip.Value >= thisform.Sip_MontoTope
		       thisform.oTxbTotalSip.DisabledBackColor= RGB(255,128,128)
		       thisform.oTxbTotalSip.DisabledForeColor= RGB(255,255,255) 
		    else
		       thisform.oTxbTotalSip.DisabledBackColor= RGB(192,192,192)
		       thisform.oTxbTotalSip.DisabledForeColor= RGB(0,0,0) 
		    endif    
			
			thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba")
			thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Deposito")
			thisform.Tg_Despachos1.Value=""
			thisform.Fecha.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha")
			thisform.Referencia.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			thisform.Numero.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo")
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Total")
			thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Impresion"))	
			thisform.oTbxMonedaTotal.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
			thisform.tg_CommandButton2.Enabled=thisform.ExisteLeyendas()
			thisform.tg_CommandButton5.Enabled=!thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado") and cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Importacion") and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"B",oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
			thisform.tg_CommandButton4.Enabled=oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",cId_comproba,"R",oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
		
		
			thisform.oTblDetalle.IrPrimero	
			Thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10))	
			Do While !Thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblImp_detalle.EsClaveIgual()
				thisform.oTblOrigenes.Buscar(thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Origen"))
				
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_articulo"		,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("id_Articulo"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"			,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Detalle"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"			,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Precio_Base_Uni"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Auxi1"			,thisform.oTblOrigenes.Leer("Nombre"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"			,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Precio_Base_Uni")*thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Despacho"			,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Despacho"))
		   		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Sip"	            ,thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Sip"))
		
				thisform.oTblDetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
				If thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sistema")=oApp.CodSistema("Importacion") and Empty(thisform.Tg_Despachos1.Value)
					thisform.Tg_Despachos1.Value=thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Despacho")		
				Endif	
				
				thisform.oTblImp_Detalle.IrSiguiente
			Enddo
			thisform.oTbxNombreComprobante.Value=oApp.ConsultarNombreComprobante(cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba)
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".id_articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Nombre"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Precio"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Total"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Auxi1"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Sip"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oTblDetalle.Alias+".Id_Despacho"
		
			thisform.oTblDetalle.IrPrimero
			Thisform.Setall("enabled",.F.,"Column")	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
			
			thisform.CargarEstadoComprobante
			
			thisform.LockScreen=.f.
			
			thisform.Refresh
		
		Endif
			
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarestadocomprobante
		If thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")
		   ThisForm.oTbxEstadoActual.Value="Anulado"
		   ThisForm.oTbxEstadoActual.DisabledBackColor=oApp.ColorRojo()
		   ThisForm.oTbxEstadoActual.DisabledForeColor=Rgb(255,255,255)
		Else
		   ThisForm.oTbxEstadoActual.Value="No anulado"
		   ThisForm.oTbxEstadoActual.DisabledBackColor=Rgb(192,192,192)
		   ThisForm.oTbxEstadoActual.DisabledForeColor=Rgb(0,0,0)
		Endif   
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarcompimportacion
		*lParameters cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		lParameters cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comprobante,nReferencia,lOcultar
		
		thisform.AnalizarPermisoConsulta(cId_comprobante, cId_Sistema)
		thisform.Reiniciar
		
		thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		*Thisform.CargarCompImportacion(cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema)
		Thisform.CargarCompImportacion(cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comprobante,nReferencia)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE existeleyendas
		Return thisform.oComp_Leyendas.Buscar(thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.Value+thisform.id_sistema)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lPArameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cid_Comproba,nReferencia,lOcultar,lOperacion
		Local mmpp
		thisform.TipoFormulario=TG_TIPOFORMCOMUN
		thisform.AnalizarPermisoConsulta(cId_comproba, cId_Sistema)
		Dodefault()
		thisform.oCultar=lOcultar
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Detalle","Tg_tabla","Imp_Detalle","Clave")	
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Cabecera","Tg_tabla","Imp_Cabecera","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaImportacion","tg_SistemaImportacion")	
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDetalle","Tg_tabla","Detalle")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_tabla","Monedas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblOrigenes","Tg_tabla","Origenes","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("otblImp_Operaciones","tg_tabla","Imp_Operaciones","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsultaComprobaOperacion","Tg_ViewConsultaComprobaOperacion")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.Sip_MontoTope= thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Sip_MontoTope")
		
		
		** Gustavo  L. 28/08/2024
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		
		** Gustavo  L. 28/08/2024
		
		
		thisform.oTblDetalle.SetearProp("BOT")
		thisform.CargarCompImportacion(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cid_Comproba,nReferencia,lOperacion)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		if Type("thisform.oDatosComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oDatosComprobante","TG_DatosComprobanteImportacion")
		Endif	
		
		*@0611/2@
		thisform.oDatosComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_sistema,ThisForm.Tg_cmbcomprobantesImportacion1.Value,thisform.Referencia.Value,Thisform.Copias)
		thisform.oDatosComprobante.Show()
		
		Thisform.Copias=thisform.oDatosComprobante.Copias
		*@0611/2@
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarleyendas
		if type("thisform.oDatosLeyenda")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oDatosLeyenda","TG_DatosLeyendas",thisform.Id_Sistema)
		
			thisform.oDatosLeyenda.Setup(thisform.Tg_cmbcomprobantesImportacion1.Value,"",thisform.REferencia.Value,thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema)	
		Endif	
			
		thisform.oDAtosLeyenda.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		If thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			thisform.tg_commandButton5.Enabled=.f. 
			if type("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante")=T_OBJECT
				thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Refrescar
			Endif
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE reiniciar
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		thisform.Tg_CmbDepositos1.Value=""
		thisform.Fecha.Value=""
		thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.Value=""
		thisform.Referencia.Value=""
		thisform.Numero.Value=""
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=0
		thisform.oTxbTotalSip.Value=0
		thisform.oTbxMonedaTotal.Value=""
		thisform.tg_despachos1.Value=""
		
		thisform.oTblDetalle.Revertir
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE vercomprobante
		** Gustavo  L. 28/08/2024
		
		do case
			case  thisform.Id_Sistema= "V"  && Consulta ventas 
				IF thisform.oTblVnt_docu.buscar(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>T_OBJECT
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.Referencia.Value,thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.Referencia.Value,thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()		
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.Id_Sistema= "C"  && Consulta Compras 
				IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.buscar(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.Referencia.Value,thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.Referencia.Value,thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()	
				ENDIF
				
		
				
		ENDCASE
		
		** Gustavo  L. 28/08/2024
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tg_btnVerComprobante.Click
		thisform.vercomprobante()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		thisform.MostrarLeyendas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton4.Click
		******* Martin
		thisform.ImprimirComprobante(thisform.Id_Sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.Value,thisform.Referencia.Value,Thisform.Copias,.f.)
		******* Martin
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton5.Click
		Local cConfirma,lAnulo,cMensaje
		
		IF thisform.oTblImp_Docu.leer("Af_Operacion") and !thisform.Operacion
		   cMensaje= "Los Comprobantes asociados a una Operación"+chr(13)+;
		             "No se Pueden Anular fuera de la Operación a"+chr(13)+;
		             "la que Pertenecen."
		   =fMensAceptar(cMensaje)
		
		Else
			cConfirma=fMensPregunto("Confirma la anulación","N",.t.)
			if cConfirma="S"
				lAnulo=.f.
				*Begin Transaction
				oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
		
				If thisform.oCstSistemaImportacion.Anular(thisform.Id_sucursal,thisform.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.Tg_cmbcomprobantesImportacion1.Value,thisform.Referencia.Value,oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
					this.Enabled=.f.
					thisform.CargarEstadoComprobante	
					lAnulo=.t.
				Endif	
				*End Transaction
				oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
				
				If lAnulo
					oApp.RefrescarAplicacion
				Endif
		
				
			Endif	
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton7.Click
		If !thisform.Ocultar
			thisform.Release
		Else
			thisform.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_CmdModificar' AS tg_commandbutton WITH ;
		Caption = "\<Modificar", ;
		Height = 17, ;
		Left = 207, ;
		Name = "Tg_CmdModificar", ;
		TabIndex = 26, ;
		Top = 333, ;
		Width = 98
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="commandbutton" />
	
	PROCEDURE anularoperacion
		local vGrabacion, cMensaje, lResul
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		lResul= .t.
		
		if thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.buscar(thisform.ID_Sucursal+Str(thisform.Nro_Operacion,10),.f.,"Clave")
		   if thisform.AnularComprobantes()
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Anulado",.T. )        
		      thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.t., .t.)
		      =fMensAceptar("Operacion Anulada !")
		   else
		      lResul= .f.
		      cMensaje= "La Operacion no ha sido Anulada debido a que"+CHR(13)+;
		                "por lo menos uno de sus comprobantes asociados"+CHR(13)+;
		                "no Puede ser Anulado"
		     =fMensAceptar(cMensaje)           
		   endif
		endif
		
		Return lResul
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarcontroles
		Thisform.Tg_cmbEstados1.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbNumero.Enabled=   .T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbFecha.Enabled=    .T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbDescripcion.Enabled=   .T.
		thisform.Tg_CmbCondicionVta1.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Enabled=    .T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbFechaEntrega.Enabled=.T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbFechaSalida.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbFechaArribo.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_TxbFechaVtoCot.Enabled= .T.
		*  Inspeccion PreEmbarque *
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_ChkSipPresentado.Enabled= .T.
		if thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_ChkSipPresentado.value
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_TxbNroSip.Enabled=             .T.
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_CmbEmpresaInspeccion1.Enabled= .T.
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_TxbFecEmisionSip.Enabled=      .T.
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_TxbNroCip.Enabled=             .T.
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_ChkCipRetirado.Enabled=        .T.
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_TxbFecRetiroCip.Enabled=       .T.
		endif
		*  Transporte       *
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbFletesInt1.Enabled=  .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbTipoFletes1.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_TxbImporte1.Enabled=    .T. 
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbFletesInt2.Enabled=  .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbTipoFletes2.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_TxbImporte2.Enabled=    .T. 
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbFletesInt3.Enabled=  .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbTipoFletes3.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_TxbImporte3.Enabled=    .T. 
		*  Medio de Pago    *
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_CmbCondicionPago1.Enabled=.T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbNroMedioPago.Enabled=  .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_TxbFecVtoPago.Enabled=    .T.   
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbNroCuenta.Enabled=     .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_CmbBancos1.Enabled=       .T.   
		
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.ReadOnly= .F.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.ReadOnly= .F.
		
		if !empty(thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.value) .and. ;
		   !empty(thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.value) .and. ;
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.value >= thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.value 
		
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.BackColor= RGB(255,128,128)
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.ForeColor= RGB(255,255,255) 
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.BackColor= RGB(255,128,128)
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.ForeColor= RGB(255,255,255) 
		else
		   if Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_OptionGroup1.value= 3
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.BackColor= RGB(255,255,255)
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.ForeColor= RGB(0,0,0) 
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.BackColor= RGB(255,255,255)
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.ForeColor= RGB(0,0,0) 
		   else
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.BackColor= RGB(192,192,192)
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.ForeColor= RGB(0,0,0) 
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.BackColor= RGB(192,192,192)
		      thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.ForeColor= RGB(0,0,0) 
		   endif
		endif
		
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_OptionGroup1.Option1.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_OptionGroup1.Option2.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_OptionGroup1.Option3.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_OptionGroup2.Option1.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_OptionGroup2.Option2.Enabled= .T.
		*  Embarque         *   
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_TxbTipoConocimiento.Enabled= .T. 
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_TxbNroConocimiento.Enabled=  .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_TxbFechaConocimiento.Enabled=.T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_TxbNombMedio.Enabled=        .T.   
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_CmbPais1.Enabled=            .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_CmbCiudades1.Enabled=        .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page4.Tg_CmbTipoLugar1.Enabled=       .T.
		*  Tipo de Embalaje *
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_CheckBox1.Enabled=           .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_OptionGroup1.Option1.Enabled=.T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_OptionGroup1.Option2.Enabled=.T.
		
		if thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_CheckBox1.value
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_TxbNroContainer.Enabled= .T.
		else
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_TxbPaquetes.Enabled=     .T.
		endif
		
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_CmbMedidaCtnr1.Enabled=   .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_TxbMetrosCubicos.Enabled= .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_TxbPesoBruto.Enabled=     .T.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page5.Tg_CmbLugarRetiro1.Enabled=  .T.
		*  Despachante    *
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_CmbDespachante1.Enabled=  .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbNroDespacho.Enabled=   .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFechaDespacho.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecEnvioDocu.Enabled=  .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecPagoAduana.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbMontoAduana.Enabled=   .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecRecepciondesp.Enabled= .T.
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecFacturaDesp.Enabled=   .T.  
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbMontoDespachante.Enabled= .T.
		*     Seguro      *
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page7.Tg_Checkbox1.Enabled= .T.
		
		if !empty( thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page7.Tg_CmbSeguros1.value )
		   thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page7.Tg_CmbSeguros1.Enabled= .T. 
		endif
		
		*     Notas       *
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page8.Tg_Editbox1.Enabled= .T.
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmdGrabar.Enabled= .T.
		ThisForm.Tg_CmdModificar.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.Tg_CmdAnular.enabled= .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdAnular.Click
		if thisform.AnularOperacion()
		   thisform.Tg_CmdModificar.enabled= .f.
		   thisform.Tg_CmdAnular.enabled= .f.
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_CmdModificar.Click
		thisform.HabilitarControles()
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cancelardescarga
		Local cConfirma,vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		cConfirma=fMensPregunto("Cancela el pendiente a descargar del comprobante","N",.t.)
		If cConfirma="S"
			thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.id_sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(thisform.Referencia,10))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cancelado_Desc",.t.)
			thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		Endif
		ThisForm.oCmdCancDescarga.Enabled=.f.
		oApp.RefrescarAplicacion
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante","Tg_ViewArticulosPendientesComprobanteImportacion")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","Imp_Cabecera","Clave")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.SetearConsulta(thisform.Id_sucursal,thisform.id_sistema,thisform.id_comproba,thisform.Referencia)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nreferencia
		
		thisform.tg_label2.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label3.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label4.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label5.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label6.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label7.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label8.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.tg_label9.Enabled=.t.
		
		
		thisform.Id_sucursal=cId_sucursal
		thisform.id_sistema=cId_Sistema
		thisform.Referencia=nreferencia
		thisform.id_comproba=cId_Comproba
		
		thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nreferencia)
		
		thisform.oLstArticulosPendientes.Clear
		
		thisform.oLblComprobante.Caption=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("NombreComprobante")
		thisform.oLblReferencia.Caption=Alltrim(str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Nro_Referencia")))
		thisform.oLblNumero.Caption=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Nro_Externo")
		thisform.oLblImporte.Caption=Alltrim(str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("TotalDeuda"),9,2))
		thisform.oLblSucursal.Caption=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("NombreSucursal")
		thisform.oLblMoneda.Caption=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("NombreMoneda")
		thisform.oLblFecha.Caption=Dtoc(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Fecha"))
		thisform.oLblCliente.Caption=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("NombreProveedor")
		
		*!*	nSaldoComprobante=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("TotalDeuda")
		
		thisform.oLstArticulosPendientes.Clear
		thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.IrPrimero
		Do while !thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.EsEof()
			If .f.
				cTextoItem=str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Fecha_Venc-Fecha"),3)+"  "+Dtoc(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Fecha_venc"))+"  "+str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Porcentaje"),6,2)+"  "+;	
						   str(nImporteVencimiento,9,2)+"  "+ str(nVencimientoImputado,9,2)+"  "+str(nSaldoVencimiento,9,2)+"  "+ str(nSaldoComprobante,9,2)		
						   
				ThisForm.oArticulosPendientes.additem(cTextoItem,thisform.oArticulosPendientes.ListCount+1,1)
			Else
				
				
				ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.additem(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
				ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.List(ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.ListCount,2)=thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Detalle")
				ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.List(ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.ListCount,3)=Str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Cantidad"),10,2)
				ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.List(ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.ListCount,4)=Str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Cantidad-Cant_Pendiente"),10,2)
				ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.List(ThisForm.oLstArticulosPendientes.ListCount,5)=Str(thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.Leer("Cant_Pendiente"),9,2)
				
			Endif
			thisform.oViewArticulosPendientesComprobante.IrSiguiente	
		
		Enddo	
		thisform.oLstArticulosPendientes.ListIndex=1
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCancDescarga.Click
		thisForm.CancelarDescarga
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label6' AS tg_label WITH ;
		AutoSize = .T., ;
		Caption = "Lista de precios", ;
		Left = 13, ;
		Name = "Tg_label6", ;
		TabIndex = 13, ;
		Top = 88, ;
		ZOrderSet = 11
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label7' AS tg_label WITH ;
		AutoSize = .T., ;
		Caption = "Visualización en pantalla", ;
		Left = 13, ;
		Name = "Tg_label7", ;
		TabIndex = 15, ;
		Top = 119, ;
		ZOrderSet = 12
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label8' AS tg_label WITH ;
		AutoSize = .T., ;
		BackColor = 192,192,192, ;
		BackStyle = 1, ;
		Caption = "Monedas", ;
		DisabledBackColor = 192,192,192, ;
		Left = 14, ;
		Name = "Tg_label8", ;
		TabIndex = 1, ;
		Top = 6, ;
		ZOrderSet = 13
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label9' AS tg_label WITH ;
		AutoSize = .T., ;
		Caption = "Modifica:", ;
		Left = 21, ;
		Name = "Tg_label9", ;
		TabIndex = 21, ;
		Top = 179, ;
		ZOrderSet = 16
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE cargarcomprobantesbase
		Local mmpp,nItemSeleccionado,mmmppp,lCargoAlgo
		mmpp=1
		lCargoAlgo=.f.
		nItemSeleccionado=1
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Clear
		For mmmppp=1 to 3
			if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]).and.!thisform.Cobranza
				if thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Buscar(thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]+"N")
				
					Do while !thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.EsEof() .and. thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]=thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("id_Comproba")
		
						if !thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("Anulado")	.and. !thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("Cancelado_Desc")	
							Dimension thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,6]
					
							With thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente
							
								if thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("nro_Referencia")	
								if thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("Id_Sucursal")	
								if thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("Id_sistema")	
								if thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.Leer("Id_Comproba")	
			
									nItemSeleccionado=mmpp
									
								Endif	
								Endif
								Endif
								Endif
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,1]=.Leer("Id_Comproba")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,2]=.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,3]=Dtoc(.Leer("Fecha"))
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,4]=.Leer("TotalDeuda")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,5]=.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,6]=.Leer("Id_Sistema")
								
						
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.additem(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,1],thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount+1,1)
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,2)=Str(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,2],7) 		
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,3)=alltrim(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,3]) 		
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,4)=str(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,4],11,2)
								lCargoAlgo=.t.				
						
							EndWith		
							mmpp=mmpp+1
						Endif	
						thisform.oImp_CabeceraPendiente.IrSiguiente
		
					Enddo
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor	
		If lCargoAlgo and thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount>0
			thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex=nItemSeleccionado
			if thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase<>0
				thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
			Endif
		Endif	
		
		ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Value=thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase<>0
		
		Thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount<>0.and.ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Value)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcomprobantesbaseoperacion
		Local mmpp,nItemSeleccionado,mmmppp,lCargoAlgo
		mmpp=1
		lCargoAlgo=.f.
		nItemSeleccionado=1
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Clear
		For mmmppp=1 to 3
			if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]).and.!thisform.Cobranza
				if thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Buscar(thisform.Id_Proveedor+"N"+thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp])
				
					Do while !thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.EsEof() .and. thisform.Id_Proveedor=thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_Proveedor").and.thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[mmmppp]=thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("id_Comproba")
		
						if !thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Anulado")	.and. !thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Cancelado_Desc")	
							Dimension thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,6]
					
							With thisform.oImp_CabeceraAdescargar
							
								if thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("nro_Referencia")	
								if thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_Sucursal")	
								if thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_sistema")	
								if thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase=thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba")	
			
									nItemSeleccionado=mmpp
									
								Endif	
								Endif
								Endif
								Endif
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,1]=.Leer("Id_Comproba")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,2]=.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,3]=Dtoc(.Leer("Fecha"))
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,4]=.Leer("TotalDeuda")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,5]=.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
								thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,6]=.Leer("Id_Sistema")
								
						
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.additem(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,1],thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount+1,1)
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,2)=Str(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,2],7) 		
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,3)=alltrim(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,3]) 		
								ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.list(thisform.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount,4)=str(thisform.vComprobantesBase[mmpp,4],11,2)
								lCargoAlgo=.t.				
						
							EndWith		
							mmpp=mmpp+1
						Endif	
						thisform.oImp_CabeceraADescargar.IrSiguiente
		
					Enddo
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor	
		If lCargoAlgo and thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount>0
			thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex=nItemSeleccionado
			if thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase<>0
				thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
			Endif
		Endif	
		
		ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Value=thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase<>0
		
		Thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount<>0.and.ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Value)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarcomprobante
		*thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oComprobanteConsulta","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase,thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase,thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase,thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase)
		
		Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oComprobanteConsulta","Tg_ConsCompImportacion", thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase, thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase, thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase, thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase )
		thisform.oComprobanteConsulta.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlarhabildescarga
		lParameters lHabilitado
		
		if ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListCount=0.or.Empty(thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[1]) 
			lHabilitado=.f.	
			thisform.tg_Label12.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oDescargaComprobante.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			thisform.tg_Label12.Enabled=.t.
			thisform.oDescargaComprobante.Enabled=.t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.tg_Label11.Enabled=lHabilitado
		thisform.tg_Label2.Enabled=lHabilitado
		
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Enabled=lHabilitado
		ThisForm.oDetalleComprobante.Enabled=lHabilitado
		if lHabilitado
			thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
		Else
			thisform.oComprobanteBaseADescargar.Value=""
			thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase=0
			thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase=""
			thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase=""
			thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase=""
			
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generarcotizacion
		Local i
		
		if type("thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta","TG_CotizacionesConsulta", thisform.ClaveCotizacion)
		Else
			thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta.LlenarGrilla(thisform.ClaveCotizacion)
		Endif
		
		thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oImp_Docu","tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oImp_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Imp_Cabecera","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Vinculaciones","tg_tabla","Cmp_Vinculaciones","clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oDepositos","tg_tabla","Depositos","Nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oImp_CabeceraADescargar","tg_tabla","Imp_Cabecera","CompDesc")
		thisform.AddObject("oImp_CabeceraPendiente","tg_tabla","Imp_Cabecera","Com_Pend")
		
		thisform.odeposito.BoundColumn=2
		thisform.odeposito.RowSourceType=6
		thisform.odeposito.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.odepositos.Alias)+".Nombre,id_deposito"
		thisform.odeposito.Style=2
		thisform.odeposito.ColumnWidths="170,0"
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrararticulospendientes
		if type("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante","TG_ConsultarArtPendComprobanteImportacion")
		
		Endif
		***** Martin
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		***** Martin
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarestadoactualcomprobante
		if type("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante","TG_EstadoActualComprobante")
		Else
			thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Refrescar
		Endif
		thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Consultar(thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_referencia"),thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_sistema"))
		thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvinculacioncomprobante
		Local oFrmConsVincula,cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		if type ("thisform.ID_sucursalEstado") <> 'L' and type("thisform.Id_sistemaEstado") <> 'L' and;
		   type ("thisform.Id_ComprobaEstado") <> 'L' and type ("thisform.Nro_ReferenciaEstado") <> 'L'
		   
			cId_Sucursal         =   thisform.ID_SucursalEstado
			cId_Sistema          =   thisform.Id_SistemaEstado
			cId_Comproba         =   thisform.Id_ComprobaEstado
			nNro_Referencia      =   thisform.Nro_ReferenciaEstado
		
			oFrmConsVincula = CreateObject("TG_FormConsVinculaMultiple")
			OFrmConsVincula.SetearConsulta(cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,cId_Sucursal,nNro_Referencia)
			oFrmConsVincula.Show()
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		ThisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.Clear
		
		*** Martin
		If !Thisform.ModoConsulta
			thisform.CargarComprobantesBase
		Endif	
		*** Martin
		if type("thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante")=T_OBJECT
			thisform.oEstadoActualComprobante.Refrescar
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarcomprobantebase
		If thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex<>0
			ThisForm.oComprobanteBaseaDescargar.Value=thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.List(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,1)+Space(6)+thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.List(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,2)
			thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase=Val(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.List(thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,2))
			thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase=thisform.vComprobantesBase[thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,5]
			thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.vComprobantesBase[thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,6]
			thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.vComprobantesBase[thisForm.oComprobantesBasePendientes.ListIndex,1]
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nReferencia,nCopias
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdEstadoComprobante.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.Id_SucursalEstado = cId_Sucursal 
		thisform.Id_ComprobaEstado = cId_Comproba
		thisform.Id_SistemaEstado  = cId_Sistema 
		thisform.Nro_ReferenciaEstado = nReferencia
		
		thisform.ClaveCotizacion = cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10)
		thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10))
		
		thisform.oImp_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba)
		
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oImp_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		*** Martin
		*!*	thisform.Cobranza=Thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Cobranza")
		*** Martin
		thisform.tg_label4.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label5.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label6.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label7.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label8.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.Or.thisform.Cobranza
		
		
		**EN CASO DE QUE EL COMPROBANTE ESTE EN EL CIRCUITO DE VINCULACION DE COMPROBANTES 
		**SE ACTIVA EL BOTON PARA MOSTRAR LAS VINCULACIONES RESPECTIVAS
		if cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("Importacion")
			if thisform.oTblCmp_vinculaciones.Buscar (cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nReferencia,10), .f., "CLAVE")
				thisform.oCmdVincula.Enabled = .t.
			else
				thisform.oCmdVincula.Enabled = .f.
			endif
		endif	
		*********************************
		
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oImp_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Impresion"))
		
		thisform.oMonedaVisualizacion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oImp_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Impresion"))
		
		thisform.oMonedaDeuda.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
				
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oImp_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Impresion"))
		thisform.oMonedaImpresion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oImp_cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Impresion"))
		thisform.oMonedaListaPrecios.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		if thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Af_Stock")<>0.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.t.
		Else
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.f.
		Endif   
		
		If thisform.Cobranza
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=""
		Else	
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=thisform.oImp_cabecera.Leer("Id_Deposito")
		Endif	
			
		thisform.oStock.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=.f.
		*@0611/2@
		thisform.oCopias.Enabled=Type("Copias") <> "L"
		If thisform.oCopias.Enabled
			Thisform.Copias=nCopias
		Endif
		*@0611/2@
		
		If thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Cancelado_Desc")
			Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			Thisform.tg_BtnAceptar1.Caption="Pendiente..."
		Endif	
		Thisform.tg_BtnCancelar2.Caption="\<Cerrar"
		
		thisform.Tg_label12.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.oDescargaComprobante.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(.f.)
		if thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Bas")<>0
			ThisForm.oComprobanteBaseaDescargar.Value=thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_com_Bas")+" "+str(thisform.oImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_bas"),10)
		Else
			ThisForm.oComprobanteBaseaDescargar.Value=""
		Endif
		
		thisform.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seteargeneral
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaDeuda)
		thisform.oMonedaDeuda.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
			
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaVisualizacion)
		thisform.oMonedaVisualizacion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
			
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaImpresion)
		thisform.oMonedaImpresion.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(thisform.MonedaListaPrecios)
		thisform.oMonedaListaPrecios.Value=iif(thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza,thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"),"")
		
		if thisform.Af_Stock<>0.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.t.
		Else
		   thisform.oStock.Value=.f.
		Endif   
		If !thisform.Cobranza
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=thisform.Id_Deposito
		Else	
			thisform.oDeposito.Value=""
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearmodificacion
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearnuevo
		lParameters cId_Comprobante,cId_Proveedor
		
		Dimension thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[3]
		
		thisform.ModoConsulta=.f.
		thisform.Id_Proveedor=cId_Proveedor
		thisform.oImp_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comprobante)
		
		thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[1]=Thisform.oImp_Docu.Leer("Id_Com_Bas")
		*thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[2]=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Com_Bas2")
		*thisform.vTipoComprobantesBase[3]=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Com_Bas3")
		
		thisform.Valorizado=Thisform.oImp_Docu.Leer("Valorizado")
		ThisForm.oCmdEstadoComprobante.Enabled=.f.
		
		thisform.SetearGeneral
		
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled = thisform.oStock.Value.and.!thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM", cId_Comprobante, "DEPOSITO", oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
		thisform.oStock.Enabled    = thisform.oImp_docu.Leer("Af_Stock")<>0.and.!thisform.Cobranza and oApp.PedirPermiso("COM", cId_Comprobante, "DEPOSITO", oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
		
		if thisform.ComprobadeOperacion
		   thisform.CargarComprobantesBaseOperacion()
		else
		   thisform.CargarComprobantesBase()
		endif
		
		thisform.tg_label4.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label5.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.or.thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label6.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label7.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.and.!thisform.Cobranza
		thisform.tg_label8.enabled=thisform.Valorizado.Or.thisform.Cobranza
		
		thisform.REfresh
		
		thisform.GuardarValores
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCotizacion.Click
		thisform.GenerarCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEstadoComprobante.Click
		thisForm.MostrarEstadoActualComprobante
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdVincula.Click
		thisform.MostrarVinculacionComprobante()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oComprobantesBasePendientes.DblClick
		thisform.ConsultarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oComprobantesBasePendientes.InteractiveChange
		thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oComprobantesBasePendientes.ProgrammaticChange
		thisform.SeleccionarComprobanteBase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oDescargaComprobante.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.ControlarHabilDescarga(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oDetalleComprobante.Click
		thisform.ConsultarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oStock.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=this.Value
		thisform.tg_Label3.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label9.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label10.Enabled=this.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oStock.ProgrammaticChange
		thisform.oDeposito.Enabled=this.Value
		thisform.tg_Label3.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label9.Enabled=this.Value	
		thisform.tg_Label10.Enabled=this.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		If !thisform.ModoConsulta
			if thisform.oStock.Value
				thisform.Af_Stock=Thisform.oImp_Docu.Leer("Af_Stock")
			ELse
				thisform.Af_Stock=0	
			Endif
			thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase=thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase
			thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase
			
			thisform.GuardarValores
			
			thisform.Hide
		Else
			thisform.MostrarArticulosPendientes	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		If !thisform.ModoConsulta
			thisform.Nro_ProvisorioBase=thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_SucursalProvComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SucursalComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_SistemaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_SistemaComprobanteBase
			thisform.Id_ComprobaProvComprobanteBase=thisform.Id_ComprobanteBase
		
			thisform.ReestablecerValores
		Endif	
		
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		AutoSize = .T., ;
		Caption = "", ;
		Height = 15, ;
		Left = 79, ;
		Name = "UsuarioConfeccion", ;
		TabIndex = 13, ;
		Top = 151, ;
		Width = 2
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nReferencia
		
		thisform.ClaveCotizacion = cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nReferencia,10)
		thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nReferencia,10))
		
		if thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Bas")<>0
			thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Com_Bas"))
			ThisForm.ComprobanteDescargado.Caption=alltrim(thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Nombre"))+": "+alltrim(str(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Bas"),10))
		ELse
			ThisForm.ComprobanteDescargado.Caption="Ninguno"
		Endif	
		
		If thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			This.FechaAnulacion.Caption=Dtoc(This.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha_Anulado"))
			This.HoraAnulacion.Caption=This.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Hora_Anulado")
			This.UsuarioAnulacion.Caption=oApp.NombreUsuario(This.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Usuario_Anulado"))
		Endif	
		
		
		ThisForm.FechaConfeccion.Caption=dtoc(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha_clock"))
		ThisForm.HoraConfeccion.Caption=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Hora")
		ThisForm.UsuarioConfeccion.Caption=oApp.NombreUsuario(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Usuario"))
		thisform.oSucursales.Buscar(thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
		thisform.Sucursal.Caption=thisform.oSucursales.Leer("Nombre")
		If thisform.oTblImp_cabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			thisform.EstadoActual.Caption="Anulado"
		Else
			thisform.EstadoActual.Caption="No anulado"
		Endif		
		
		thisform.tg_Label4.Enabled=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")	
		thisform.tg_Label5.Enabled=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")	
		thisform.tg_Label6.Enabled=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")	
		thisform.tg_Label7.Enabled=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")	
		ThisForm.Tg_3dshape2.Enabled=thisform.oTblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")		
			
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generarcotizacion
		Local i
		
		if type("thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta","TG_CotizacionesConsulta", thisform.ClaveCotizacion)
		Else
			thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta.LlenarGrilla(thisform.ClaveCotizacion)
		Endif
		
		thisform.oCotizacionesConsulta.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Cabecera","Tg_tabla","Imp_Cabecera","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oSucursales","Tg_tabla","Sucursales","Clave")
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCotizacion.Click
		
		Thisform.GenerarCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE aplicarcoeficiente
		LParameters nCoeficiente
		
		local vDatos[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while not Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.EsEof()
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Coef",nCoeficiente)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpCoef", Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("Precio") * nCoeficiente)
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darcoeficiente
		LParameters nRenglon
		
		Local nCoef
		
		nCoef=1
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrPrimero()
		Do while Not Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.EsEof()
			
			If nRenglon=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("Renglon")
				nCoef=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("Coef")
				Exit
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Return nCoef
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darimportecosto
		LParameters nRenglon
		
		Local nImpCoef
		
		nImpCoef=0
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrPrimero()
		Do while Not Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.EsEof()
			
			If nRenglon=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("Renglon")
				nImpCoef=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("ImpCoef")
				Exit
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Return nImpCoef
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes","Tg_Tabla","Aux_ImpCoeficientes")
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.SetearProp("Bot")
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.CurrentControl="Text1"
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".Id_Articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".Cantidad"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".Precio"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".Total"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".Coef"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Alias + ".ImpCoef"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setup
		lParameters vDetalle,cCantidadPicture,cPrecioPicture
		
		Local i,vDatos[1,2]
		
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,1]="Id_Articulo"
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,2]="Cantidad"								
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,3]="Nombre"
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,4]="Precio"
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,5]="Total"
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,6]="coef"
		*!*	vDetalle[mmpp,7]="Recno()"
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCoeficiente.Value=1
		
		For i = 1 to Alen(vDetalle,1)
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Id_Articulo", vDetalle[i,1] )
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Cantidad",vDetalle[i,2])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Nombre",vDetalle[i,3])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Precio",vDetalle[i,4])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Total",vDetalle[i,5])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"coef",1)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Renglon",vDetalle[i,7])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpCoef",vDetalle[i,4])
				
			Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		Next
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.InputMask=cCantidadPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.tg_TextGrid1.InputMask=cCantidadPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask=cPrecioPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.tg_TextGrid1.InputMask=cPrecioPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.InputMask=cPrecioPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.tg_TextGrid1.InputMask=cPrecioPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.InputMask=cPrecioPicture
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.tg_TextGrid1.InputMask=cPrecioPicture
		
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkAplicar.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdAplicar.Enabled			=	This.Value
		ThisForm.oTbxCoeficiente.Enabled	=	This.Value
		ThisForm.oLblCoeficiente.Enabled	=	This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkAplicar.ProgrammaticChange
		ThisForm.oCmdAplicar.Enabled			=	This.Value
		ThisForm.oTbxCoeficiente.Enabled	=	This.Value
		ThisForm.oLblCoeficiente.Enabled	=	This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAplicar.Click
		Thisform.AplicarCoeficiente(ThisForm.oTbxCoeficiente.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		Thisform.Cancelado=.f.
		Thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		Thisform.Cancelado=.t.
		Thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column6.Text1.LostFocus
		local vDatos[1,2],nPrecio,nCoef
		
		nPrecio=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("Precio")
		nCoef=Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Leer("Coef")
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpCoef",nPrecio * nCoef)
		Thisform.oTblAux_ImpCoeficientes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE anularcomprobantes
		local lResul
		lResul= .t.
		
		if thisform.validarComprobantes()
		   if thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.buscar(thisform.id_Sucursal+Str(thisform.Nro_Operacion,10),.f.,"Operacion")
		      
		      do while !thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.eseof() and ;
		         thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("id_Sucursal")+Str(thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Operacion"),10)= thisform.id_Sucursal+Str(thisform.Nro_Operacion,10)
		         
		         if !thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")
		            
		            lResul= thisform.oCstSistemaImportacion.Anular(thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("id_Sucursal"),thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("id_Sistema"),thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("id_Comproba"),thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"))
		
		         endif   
		          
		         thisform.otblImp_Cabecera.irSiguiente
		      enddo 
		   endif
		else
		   lResul= .f.
		endif
		
		Return lResul   
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartotalflete
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.tg_txbimporteFlete.value = thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.tg_txbimporte1.value + ;
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.tg_txbimporte2.value + thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.tg_txbimporte3.value 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargaraltaoperacion
		thisform.Nro_Operacion=  thisform.otblParametros.leer("pro_Operacion")
		thisform.id_Sucursal= oApp.CodSucursal()
		
		thisform.tg_TxbReferencia.value= thisform.Nro_Operacion
		thisform.tg_TxbFecha.value= oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		Thisform.tg_TxbFechaEntrega.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbFechaSalida.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbFechaArribo.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbFechaVtoCot.value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page1.tg_TxbFecEmisionSip.value    = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page1.tg_TxbFecRetiroCip.value     = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_TxbFecVtoPago.value       = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.value   = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page3.tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.value   = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page4.tg_TxbFechaConocimiento.value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFechaDespacho.value    = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecEnvioDocu.value     = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecPagoAduana.value    = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecRecepciondesp.value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.Page6.tg_TxbFecFacturaDesp.value   = cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoProrroga.Enabled= .F.
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page3.Tg_TxbFecVtoBancario.Enabled= .F.
		
		thisform.CargarCodigoNoAsignado()
		
		thisform.oTblImp_Estados.IrPrimero
		
		Do while !thisform.oTblImp_Estados.EsEof()
		   if thisform.oTblImp_Estados.Leer("pri_Estado") 
		       ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.SetearDefault(thisform.oTblImp_Estados.Leer("Id_Estado"))
		    endif
		   thisform.oTblImp_Estados.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbMonedas1.SetearDefault(thisform.otblParametros.Leer("Mon_def"))
		
		Thisform.CargarvaloresOperacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargarcodigonoasignado
		thisform.Tg_CmbCondicionVta1.value = thisform.otblImp_CodNoAsigando.Leer("Id_CondicionVta")
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_CmbEmpresaInspeccion1.value  = thisform.otblImp_CodNoAsigando.Leer("Id_EmpInsp")
		thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbFletesInt1.value  = thisform.otblImp_CodNoAsigando.Leer("Id_Flete")

	PROCEDURE cargarconsultaoperacion
		lParameters nNro_Operacion, cId_Sucursal
		
		thisform.Nro_Operacion= nNro_Operacion
		thisform.id_Sucursal= cId_Sucursal
		thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.buscar(cID_Sucursal+Str(nNro_Operacion,10),.f.,"Clave")
		
		thisform.Estado= thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Estado")
		Thisform.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value=   thisform.Estado   
		thisform.Tg_TxbReferencia.value= nNro_Operacion
		
		if thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Anulado")
		   thisform.Tg_CmdModificar.enabled= .f.
		   thisform.Tg_CmdAnular.enabled= .f.
		else
		   thisform.Tg_CmdModificar.enabled= .t.
		   thisform.Tg_CmdAnular.enabled= .t.
		endif
		
		thisform.Tg_TxbNumero.value = thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Nro_Externo")
		thisform.Tg_TxbFecha.value  = thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Fecha")
		thisform.Tg_TxbDescripcion.value = thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Descripcion")

		thisform.Tg_CmbCondicionVta1.value = IIF(EMPTY(thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Id_CondicionVta")),thisform.otblImp_CodNoAsigando.Leer("Id_CondicionVta"),thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Id_CondicionVta"))
		thisform.Tg_CmbMonedas1.value = thisform.otblImp_Operaciones.Leer("Id_Moneda")

		Thisform.Old_descripcion=  thisform.Tg_TxbDescripcion.value
		Thisform.OldId_Proveedor=  thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.value
		Thisform.OldCondicion_vta= thisform.Tg_CmbCondicionVta1.value
		Thisform.OldId_Moneda=   thisform.Tg_CmbMonedas1.value
		Thisform.OldFec_Entrega= thisform.Tg_TxbFechaEntrega.value
		Thisform.OldFec_Salida=  thisform.Tg_TxbFechaSalida.value
		Thisform.OldFec_Arribo=  thisform.Tg_TxbFechaArribo.value
		Thisform.OldFec_VtoCotiza= thisform.Tg_TxbFechaVtoCot.value

		Thisform.Oldfec_EmisionSip= thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_TxbFecEmisionSip.value
		Thisform.OldNro_Cip= thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page1.Tg_TxbNroCip.value

		Thisform.OldTipo_Flete2= thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbTipoFletes2.value
		Thisform.OldFlete_Importe2= thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_TxbImporte2.value

		Thisform.OldTipo_Flete3= thisform.Tg_Pageframe1.page2.Tg_CmbTipoFletes3.value
